items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: I was lucky enough to fall downstairs with Albert Coise and stayed there 36 years. That's what kept me in the business.

ctx.x: Until... We got put up before the union for playing underscale at WSMB.

And it was less than that. We stayed there two years until the station let us go. And when the station let us go, I was lucky enough to fall downstairs with Albert Coise and stayed there 36 years. That's what kept me in the business.
